help_text:
🆘 **Help**

📌 **Available Commands:**

/publish - Publish posts
/add - Add channel
/mychannels - View my channels
/security - Security settings
/panel - Control panel
/lock - Lock group
/unlock - Unlock group
/stats - Bot statistics
/developer - Developer info
/language - Change language
/support - Support
/trial - Activate trial
/subscribe - Subscribe
/contests - Contests
/replies - View auto replies
plan_selector:
💎 **Choose Your Plan**

🔹 Select the subscription duration:
not_authorized: ❌ You are not authorized to use this command
subscription_expired: ❌ Your subscription has expired or you don't have one
max_posts_reached: ❌ You have reached the maximum number of posts
enter_posts:
📝 Send posts (count: {count})
You can send text, photo, video, document, audio, etc.
enter_channel_id:
📡 Enter channel ID (e.g., @channel or -100123456789)

📌 Make sure the bot is an admin in the channel with post permission.
invalid_format: ❌ Invalid format. Use @username or numeric ID.
invalid_channel: ❌ This is not a channel. Please check the ID.
channel_exists: ❌ Channel already exists in your list
channels_empty:
📭 No channels registered

Use /add to add a new channel.
trial_used: ❌ You have already used your trial
send_support_message:
📝 Send your message and it will be delivered to support

✏️ Explain your issue in detail and we'll reply soon.
support_ticket_created:
✅ Ticket #{num} created!
We'll get back to you soon.
admin_add_admin: 👑 Enter user ID to add as admin:
admin_rem_admin: 🗑️ Enter user ID to remove from admins:
admin_broadcast_confirm:
📨 **Confirm Broadcast**

Message:
{text}

Are you sure you want to send this to all users?
confirm_delete_tickets: 🗑️ Are you sure you want to delete all tickets?
import_from_github_prompt: 📥 Enter GitHub JSON file URL to import replies:
import_github_invalid_url: ❌ Invalid URL. Please check the link.
import_github_failed: ❌ Failed to load from GitHub. Check the URL.
enter_word: 📝 Enter word to add to banned list:
enter_word_to_remove: 📝 Enter word to remove from banned list:
groups_empty:
📭 No groups

Add the bot to a group and use /syncgroup to activate.
